fundamental.summary: COST shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings 13 days away.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (302.6), strong dollar pressures multinational revenues, FOMC just concluded, and earnings binary event in 13 days create compounded downside risk for COST.
